title: bilattice-homomorphism-naturality
description: The condition that a bilattice homomorphism between predication fiber algebras commutes with the entity-relabeling action, i.e. is equivariant under permutations of the entity set so that no particular entity is treated specially.

homomorphism.description: the underlying arrow phi : A_q -> A_p between predication fiber algebras being tested for naturality

entity-set.description: the set E of entities whose permutations Sym(E) act on each fiber algebra

permutation-action.description: for each permutation sigma of E, the induced relabeling sigma* acting on A_q and on A_p

equivariant.description: for every sigma in Sym(E): sigma* . phi = phi . sigma*; phi is Sym(E)-equivariant and depends only on fiber structure, not on particular entities
